structures.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "shop"."big_orders" AS
 SELECT id,
    total
   FROM shop.orders
  WHERE total > 100::numeric;

CREATE TABLE "shop"."customers" (
    "id" integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
    "email" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
    "name" text,
    CONSTRAINT "customers_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT "customers_email_key" UNIQUE (email)
);

constraints.name: orders_customer_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES shop.customers(id) ON UPDATE SET NULL ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (customer_id WITH =, during WITH &&)

triggers.name: orders_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_audit AFTER DELETE ON shop.orders FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION shop.touch()

triggers.name: orders_touch
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_touch BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON shop.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop.touch()

structures.ddl:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW "shop"."totals" AS
 SELECT customer_id,
    sum(total) AS s
   FROM shop.orders
  GROUP BY customer_id;

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM shop.orders ORDER BY id
